column_semantics: The schedule has a single position-level Coupon column. For PIK instruments, the Coupon cell prints the all-in coupon first and then parenthetically identifies the PIK portion of that coupon. The Reference and Spread columns are separate rate components; there are no separate Cash and PIK rate columns.

rationale: The filing uses disclosure pattern 1. The March 31, 2026 schedule has one Coupon column rather than separate Cash and PIK columns, and PIK is shown in parentheses inside that Coupon cell. The printed number before the parenthetical is therefore the all-in coupon, with the parenthetical amount identifying the PIK component included in that stated coupon. Footnote (3) does not alter this; it only says that investments without an interest rate are non-income producing.
